pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Balm on your own computer in one line and sign in as the owner.

pages.title: Set up your clinic
pages.summary: Your clinic details, services, practitioners and reception, weekly hours and sign-in invitations.

pages.title: Deploy to your own Cloudflare account
pages.summary: Put Balm online in your own Cloudflare account with SendGrid or Resend for email, and remove it again with one command.

pages.title: Bookings and the schedule
pages.summary: The calendar by day or week and by practitioner or room, online booking at /book, moving and canceling visits, and recurring visits.

pages.title: The waitlist
pages.summary: Keep clients waiting for a time; a canceled visit is offered to them by email and the first to accept is booked.

pages.title: Intake forms
pages.summary: The private intake link each new booking gets, who reads the answers, and changing the questions with the form builder.

pages.title: Treatment notes
pages.summary: PT, OT and speech templates, CPT units by the 8-minute rule, drafting with the scribe, signing, addenda and unsigned notes on the schedule.

pages.title: Plan of care
pages.summary: Sign a plan of care with goals, frequency and duration, and have the referring physician certify it from an emailed link.

pages.title: Invoices and payments
pages.summary: Prepare an invoice from an attended visit, approve and number it, download it and record payments you receive.

pages.title: Patient payments
pages.summary: Connect Stripe, save cards with the patient's consent, charge copays at check-in, send pay links, and give patients statements and superbills.

pages.title: Appointment reminders
pages.summary: Balm writes the exact reminder text for an upcoming visit; a person approves it and sends it their usual way.

pages.title: People, roles and the access audit
pages.summary: Owner, practitioners and reception, removing access at once, erasing records, and the audit on every client file.

pages.title: Agent commands
pages.summary: Give an assistant a key so it can prepare invoices, reminder text and intake versions for a person to approve.

pages.title: Move in from Cliniko
pages.summary: Upload Cliniko's patient export, check the preview with US dates, import it, read the journal and undo it if needed.

pages.title: Back up and restore
pages.summary: Export the whole clinic to one archive and restore it into a fresh copy.
